title: A value with a byte that is not UTF-8
how: The value `caf` is followed by the single byte 0xE9; the file is read with the bad byte replaced and the reader says so (PHOENIX-KICAD-012).
One footprint = 1 component with 2 pads; net 1 is the only net; pad 1 names net 1 and pad 2 names none = 1 pad net.
